answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes fresh challenge words, e.g. plume, sparrow, onyx, and every agent must respond to that epoch's prompt incorporating them. Because the words are unknown until the epoch starts, sybil attackers cannot precompute template answers or reuse cached work across fake identities; each identity must do genuine, unique per-epoch work, so cost scales linearly with every sybil instead of once, making mass fake identities uneconomical.
